node.title: KoalaBear m3 primitive-outer degree-two router
node.closure: complete primitive degree-20 subdegree exclusion plus exact composite-destination routing
node.statement: For each of the five inner-degree-three transverse types, an indecomposable outer degree-20 map would require a primitive group with subdegree 2, 3, 4, 6, or 12. The complete primitive degree-20 catalogue consists of PSL(2,19), PGL(2,19), A20, and S20, all with subdegrees 1,19. Thus the outer map decomposes; its proper right-factor destinations have inner degree 6,12,15,30, and the proved routers make each impossible or furnish an inner-degree-two decomposition. Inner degree three is not an independent producer, leaving the three m=2 types. No m3 nonexistence or owner charge is claimed.
